steps.text: Two men strike forward in the wide, dark sewers.
The sound of water is loud and grating, even more sinister than unbroken silence.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Hold on a minute. Make a right here.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You sure know this place well.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Of course I do.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Something every spy should know?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: The first thing every spy should know.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Then I'm sure you've already been working in the Afterglow for years.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Trying to get on my good side?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Just curious.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: You're not privy to that information.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Disappointing.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Why'd you stop moving?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: There's something over there.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: That's the oldest trick in the book. Don't even bother.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: No, I'm serious – Look over there, something's moving.
Biegler presses the weapon in his hand against Graf Urtica's heart from behind, his eyes then following the direction of the Graf's fingers.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: It's just an Originium slug. You've never seen one of those before?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Is it really... just an Originium slug?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: The high-and-mighty Graf Urtica was so scared by an Originium slug that he couldn't even walk. Now I've seen everything.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I still think there's something not quite right...

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Stop being stupid and get a move on!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Wait, just a second.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Isn't that an awful lot of slugs?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: That's way too many! This is going to be a major problem!

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Run! Now!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Why are you––

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: It's about to be too late already! Hurry up!
Biegler grasps Ebenholz's wrist tightly, and the two of them sprint through the sewers.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Huff, huff...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Do you have a map of the sewers inside your head?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: If you have the time to quip at me, you'd be better off spending it to catch your breath.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm not trying to be sarcastic, every branch we take seriously looks the same to me...

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Rested up?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: We just––

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Then keep running! Hurry!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Gasps)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I... can't keep going...

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: That's fine. We just happened to find who we were looking for.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Good evening, Herr Lachmann.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: Good evening, shopkeep.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Shopkeep?

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: Ugh. You don't know a damned thing, but you still have to stick your nose where it doesn't belong. What a pain you are.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: Wouldn't you agree, Biegler?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: But you're the one who's in real trouble.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: You've provoked all the Originium slugs in this area, and they're swarming towards the surface.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: As we both know, the Originium slugs in the sewers emit a noxious gas, and what you're doing is tantamount to a chemical attack on the Infected of the Afterglow.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: A chemical attack? But aren't we fine right now?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: The gas has a much stronger effect on the Infected than it does on you, Graf Urtica.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Then, Czerny and Hibiscus...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: And Kreide too...?!

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Good. You already understand the situation.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Lachmann, quell these Originium slugs and return them to their original state immediately, or I will exercise my right to put you down on the spot.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: It's no longer possible.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: A lone man can start a fire easy enough, but even if you point a knife at his neck, he won't be able to put it out alone.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: What do you people get out of this?

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: What do we get? How do you not even know that much?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Not interested in hearing your riddles.

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: 'Pestilence from Shadow wanton spouts, spews Ruin in Prelude.'

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: Do you really need me to explain it word by word?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Let me rephrase. What do you get out of making the prophecy come true?

steps.name: Lachmann
steps.text: You don't need to worry about that.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: What are you trying to do? Silence him?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Just knock him out already, my dear, mean-spirited spy!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Do you have any way of controlling these slugs?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: If I did, I wouldn't be wasting my breath on him.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Then let's get going before it's too late!

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: (Glares sharply)

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: You're more than meets the eye, Graf Urtica.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Fine, I'll carry him out, and you follow me––

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Wait, hold up, that's––
Ebenholz sees the same thing Biegler sees.
Where Lachmann has fallen, something silvery is glistening on the sewer wall.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: It's the keyhole.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: There might be some kind of device inside controlling the Originium slugs! I'll blow the door open––

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Let me see if I can pick the lock first.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: It'd be bad news if you blew up something important.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Can you open it?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: The lock's a pretty tough nut to crack, but it won't get the better of me.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: While you're working on that, mind telling me what this prophecy is all about?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: You've never heard of it?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Well, whatever, it's spreading around anyway.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: O'er lofty Hills, the Fiend steps into Twilight's Midst agaze.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: The Blood hides Plague within, slow beckons Death to creep all Ways.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Pestilence from Shadow wanton spouts, spews Ruin in Prelude.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Fades Finale's Ensemble; Woe departs with Sun's last Rays.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Ensemble? Woe?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: To be honest, I'm still curious what the last verse means.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Everything else is already fairly clear.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: The first verse refers to Hibiscus's arrival in the Afterglow, and the second refers to the phenomenon of false recovery...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You even know about that?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: What do you think a spy's job is?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Now, the third verse is also clear. All that remains is the last one.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: It's open.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Now, that's something...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: A laboratory?!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Ah, it's you. Thank you for organizing––

steps.name: Mannered Infected
steps.text: Herr Czerny, the situation outside has gone to hell in a handbasket!

steps.name: Mannered Infected
steps.text: Swarms of noxious Originium slugs started coming up from the sewers, and a lot of people have already been poisoned. It's total chaos out in the streets now!

steps.name: Mannered Infected
steps.text: They're saying this is part of the prophecy, and panic is spreading through the Afterglow!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: How did this all happen?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: We can't do much about people panicking right now, but how about those who were poisoned?

steps.name: Mannered Infected
steps.text: They're not looking too good... Especially those whose Oripathy started getting better recently. They're having even more violent reactions.

steps.name: Mannered Infected
steps.text: We've already contacted the hospital, but the medical staff on the line didn't seem very motivated when they heard that we're in the Afterglow...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Not motivated?!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I'll go negotiate with the hospital then.

steps.name: Mannered Infected
steps.text: It's too dangerous outside, you'd better just call!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: If they didn't care when you made the call, it won't make a difference if I'm the one on the line. This is something I'll have to take care of in person.

steps.name: Mannered Infected
steps.text: But tomorrow's the day of the concert, and if you get poisoned...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: If these inexplicable events result in deaths, do you think people will be in any mood to enjoy the music, even if the concert continues as planned?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I don't want things to reach that point, nor do I want to pretend as if nothing is happening. I'd rather not play a single note than lie to myself!

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Why are there so many slugs?!

steps.name: Neurotic Infected
steps.text: It reeks! What is this stench...?

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: I'll help you, let's get out of here!

steps.name: Neurotic Infected
steps.text: Looks like... the prophecy is coming true...

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Damn pests, stay away!

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Krause, Krause! Get up–– *cough*, *cough*...

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Help us! Someone, anyone!

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Is someone playing the cello...? All the slugs are going in the direction of the music?

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Krause, stand up. Here, hold on to my shoulder...

steps.name: Worn-out Infected
steps.text: Hold on tight. Let's go, now!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: (Whispers) You're welcome.
With Kreide at the epicenter, the tones of the cello spread out across the narrow streets and alleys of the Afterglow.
Wherever the cello's notes travel, the Originium slugs turn around one after another.
Those who had been surrounded think the crisis is over, that the poison-exhaling insects will soon retreat to the dark sewers under the guidance of the cello's tune.
But they are wrong.
Both where they can and cannot see, Originium slugs make their way towards Kreide.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Huff, *pant*, *pant*...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Finally... made it...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Now what... Do I just blow all these slugs up with Arts?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: ––Something's not right here.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Now what is it, my good spy?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: The Originium slugs are all congregating in one place––

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: A cello...?!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Kreide, what are you doing? Stop that right now–– *cough*, *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: No yelling. It won't do any good and will only mess up your lungs.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Help me get through!

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: I told you, stop shouting.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: He won't stop playing just because you're shouting, and I won't stand aside just because you aren't.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Then, let's combine forces and clear a path to Kreide!

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: I don't think so. I'll head in the opposite direction.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Are you going back to your coffee shop?

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Yes. We worked together to create an opening. Now, we will part ways.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm sure you can't wait to head back to your shop and study those torn documents you retrieved from the lab, right?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm so glad the research notes about the Voice of Mundane are so much more interesting than the lives of the Infected.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Kreide's situation is your own damned fault, so you can solve it yourself.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Also, if I find out that even a single word in those notes and plans was written by you, just you wait.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'll be waiting, sure enough.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: That's the end of our chat.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: We're going, on the count of three!
